# armilla-decoder

> Exact decoder mathematics on residue rings

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-decoder && cd armilla-decoder && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q numpy && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/check.py h264` (expect: PASS).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 + Free Trial; CC BY 4.0 documents.
